notes.title: Tyrannis: Co-Prosperity July 20 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey, another quick update.

Originally, I was trying to see how to deal with island chains.

One idea I had was to have them be separate, so combat would be isolated on the islands.

The problem is that this can lead to Security players just camping out there like it's Australia in Risk, and that gets annoying fast.

So to fix that, I'm reworking movement on the islands to be more like regular territory.

notes.title: Tyrannis: Co-Prosperity July 3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey, Chris here with a quick hotfix:

After listening to your feedback, I've added a few tweaks that should improve the Tyrannis: Co-Prosperity experience.

Well, two big tweaks.

[h1]Skipping Battles[/h1]

When you're fighting across an entire Area worth of territory, there will be a whole lot of battles.

On the other hand, you might not want to click through hundreds of battles all at once, right?

Starting in the Main Menu, go to "Options," and then "Battle Options" to toggle the types of battles you want to see.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/f098b597da986a1ce999ff76d152e8259a356b46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/db6cf0c96bf264c5d883b8e0c6d2f15163fb6928.png[/img]
[h2]Districts[/h2]
"Districts" adjusts which Battles are shown based on location, with "Show All" showing you every Battle in every District, "Allied Only" only showing you Battles in Allied-controlled Districts, "Player Only" limiting Battles to player-controlled Districts, and "Skip All" skipping all Battles in all districts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/c4a310bd423ddc7abe27cb6f9a5064199aced955.png[/img]
[h2]Attacking[/h2]
"Attacking" will show Battles based on the Factions attacking. "Show All" will show every Battle, while "Allied Only" limits it to Battles with player-allied Factions Attacking, and "Player Only" will skip all attacks without player-controlled Units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/90d169dd008fc3cc67ef4361b883dffa93d81c78.png[/img]
[h2]Defending[/h2]
"Defending" will show Battles based on the Factions defending. "Show All" will show every Battle, while "Allied Only" limits it to Battles with player-allied Factions have units defending, and "Player Only" will skip all defensive Battles without player-controlled Units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/dbc78b8e01cd338a8a19fdc2dfd2c1b1e8267376.png[/img]
[h2]Combinationss[/h2]
Please note that you can mix-and-match these settings. For example, if you set it to "Districts: Player Only," "Attacking: Player Only," and "Defending: Player Only," then the only Battles shown will be ones that have player-controlled Units or take place in player-controlled Districts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/2ba23d736900362c758882f7092fc79ebca4355b.png[/img]
[h1]Default Factions[/h1]

Do you like playing Tyrannis, but you just want to get into a Skirmish, instead of creating your own faction?

Well, that's a thing you can do now with the Default Factions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/2f0cf6832e4d3760e6383904cf31ff7913c36fb8.png[/img]
These are two basic factions known as "BLUFOR," the default Freelancer faction, and "REDFOR," the default Security faction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/55e0fb1e3eee71f5376049e37d1453fdfbe9b537.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225607/ee462dc082b14ed5d7fa970baf795a9a20f7bc26.png[/img]
Choose these factions if you want to get into the thick of a Skirmish, right out of the gate.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]

Anyways, that should do it for the hotfixes for Tyrannis: Co-Prosperity.

Well, that, and I fixed that bug where randomly clicking would automatically return you to the Skirmish Menu.

Happy Fourth of July and/or Steam Sale!

-Chris Lawrence
